targets.notes: Write operations remain disabled until flash geometry and a deterministic YWD-1278 firmware artifact are re-qualified in this repository. GPIO20=BOOT0 and GPIO21=RESET were physically validated on the reference Pi 5/HAT; normal application release is BOOT0 low and RESET high and does not pulse RESET. The installer may use this profile as an auto-release candidate only after a direct read-only probe fails and the install flow has user authorization. Stock restore must use a protected backup whose captured identity appears in stock_identities.
